annotation.bound_parties_text: The standard specifies safety requirements for driverless industrial trucks and their systems, with hazards considered as foreseeable by the manufacturer, so it is addressed to manufacturers.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: under conditions of misuse which are reasonably foreseeable by the manufacturer.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Examples of driverless industrial trucks (trucks as defined in ISO 5053‑1:2020) include: “automated guided vehicle”, “autonomous mobile robot”
